items.name: use-mobile
items.title: useIsMobile
items.description: Boolean hook that is true below the md breakpoint (768px by default). Safe for SSR: false on the server and first render, then live via matchMedia.
items.author: Tanfust <https://tanfust.com>

items.name: use-media-query
items.title: useMediaQuery
items.description: Subscribe to any CSS media query with useSyncExternalStore. Returns false on the server, tracks the query live on the client. No hydration mismatch.
items.author: Tanfust <https://tanfust.com>

items.name: use-debounce
items.title: useDebounce / useDebouncedCallback
items.description: Debounce a value or a callback. useDebounce returns the value after it stops changing; useDebouncedCallback returns a stable function that runs the latest callback after the delay.
items.author: Tanfust <https://tanfust.com>

items.name: use-copy-to-clipboard
items.title: useCopyToClipboard
items.description: Copy text to the clipboard and get a short-lived status (idle, copied, error) to drive a Copy button label. Resets automatically.
items.author: Tanfust <https://tanfust.com>

items.name: use-stepper
items.title: useStepper
items.description: State machine for multi-step flows: current step, next/back/skip/goTo, completed and skipped sets, progress fraction, optional steps and onComplete. Typed by your step ids.
items.author: Tanfust <https://tanfust.com>
